title: Keeping track of what you've shared
intro: My links keeps a record of every link you have made, from any file or folder, whether it still works or not.

sections.heading: See your links
steps: Click **My links** in the left rail.
Click the chips above the list to show or hide links by status.
bullets: **Paused** links will not open, because you lost the right to edit the file or folder. The card explains why.
**Expired** links have passed their expiry date.
**Revoked** links are ones you turned off.
**Deleted** links point to a file or folder that no longer exists.
sections.tip: Each card shows who the link was sent to and when it expires. It also shows how often it was opened, and whether it needs a password.

sections.heading: Revoke a link
steps: Click **Revoke** on the link's card, then click **Revoke link** to confirm.
sections.note: Nobody can use the link after that. Colleagues who already had access in Depot keep it.

sections.heading: Keep an eye on links from Home
bullets: The **Links you sent** card on Home lists your newest links, and whether each has been opened.
A bar above your libraries on Home warns you when a link expires within a week.
